summary_en: KOA SHOJI HOLDINGS updated its approach to capital cost-conscious management and share price awareness on September 17, 2026. The update includes current analysis and evaluation, along with future initiatives for improvement.
title_en: Response to Realize Management with Awareness of Capital Cost and Share Price (Update)
translation_en_brief: On September 17, 2026, KOA SHOJI HOLDINGS' Board of Directors approved an update to the company's approach toward realizing management with heightened awareness of capital cost and share price levels. The announcement indicates that the company has conducted a current analysis and evaluation of its existing initiatives and has determined future measures for improvement, though the specific details of the update are contained in the attached materials. This represents an ongoing refinement of the company's capital allocation strategy and shareholder value creation objectives.
